build_TCN_backbone: build a TCN backbone model with 1024 stem channels and 2 temporal blocks for pose estimation
build_BasicTemporalBlock: build a BasicTemporalBlock with causal convolutions and residual connections for VideoPose3D
run_TCN_forward: run the TCN forward pass on input tensor with shape batch x channels x sequence_length
run_BasicTemporalBlock_forward: run the BasicTemporalBlock forward pass with dilated 1D convolutions and optional dropout
review_TCN_stride_conv: review the TCN use_stride_conv optimization that replaces dilated convolutions with strided convolutions for single-frame batching
